result.rule: per_seed_v1: a cooperative plan need not generalise across traffic seeds. Every (plan, seed) verification is its own example: admit it iff THAT seed's per-unit paired block bootstrap (policy-continues minus plan, B=2000, RNG 20261103 re-seeded per example, circular 30 s blocks or per-vehicle units) has one-sided 95% lower bound > 0 AND that seed's composite safety check on its OWN deltas passes (seed 1: extended window; seed 2: replication window [+ seed-2 extended when recorded]; absent own deltas = data_missing, no fallback) AND that seed later-harm (extended-window) check passes when measured. Seed-2 later-harm is used when a seed-2 extended window is recorded, else NOT MEASURED, disclosed per example and admitted only under SEED2_UNMEASURED_LATER_HARM=admit (never imputed). Imitation pairs of an example come from THAT seed's plan-branch tape. Cooperative label per example: that seed's best-solo minus group per-unit bootstrap lower bound > 0 when that seed's solos exist, else no_solos (admitted, not cooperative). replicated = cooperative on both seeds (reporting only; weights unchanged).
